mostWorthwhile.text: Building the folded lining and bringing capillaries close to it helped explain how a lot of surface fits into a small space and why nutrients have only a short distance to cross.

leastWorthwhile.text: The two nutrient crossings were quite similar, so following the second felt a little repetitive.

surprise.text: Glucose reaches the liver before entering the wider circulation; I had not expected that particular route.

arbitrary.text: The separate blood-route combination felt a little unclear: connecting the vein to the lining at step 3 seemed to show that route already, but the goal still needed step 6.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter if it builds on these connections. Seeing how the lining, blood and liver link up was interesting, even though some steps felt repetitive.
